description: §8.1.2 (S456 fix round F2) — a `;`-chained `?{}` inside an `if` condition. The condition is expression text the parser holds unparsed (an escape-hatch), lowered by codegen's text path; the one-statement check (and the §14.8.10 allow-list) read the same body there. On main d2bc3a065 this compiled clean.
rationale: §8.1.2: every program-body `?{}` — statement position, expression position, and a `?{}` inside expression text the compiler holds unparsed (an `if` / `while` condition, a template-literal slot, a raw `match` arm) — holds exactly one SQL statement.
